scope: Known limitations from independent question review and implementation boundaries; not an exhaustive legal-domain audit

categories.MISSING_KNOWLEDGE: No implemented substantive rule for the requested obligation or period
categories.INSUFFICIENT_SOURCE_EVIDENCE: Available admitted passages do not establish all required premises
categories.INCORRECT_SEMANTIC_MAPPING: The requested issue is not mapped to the relevant supported rule or fact role
categories.MISSING_CASE_FACTS: A correct general rule exists, but individual application or arithmetic needs additional facts

ACRA.topic: Annual-return CEO question using month/year wording
ACRA.detail: Date-scope handling blocks the supported commencement explanation.
New commencement rule is not retrospectively applied; complete earlier requirements are not established.
Existing bounded rules remain; the secretary capture does not itself implement all appointment, qualification, vacancy and AGM exceptions.

IRAS.detail: General medical restrictions are explained; the specific blocked example is omitted from the rendered explanation.

IRAS.topic: Other specific GST treatments and blocked-claim exceptions
IRAS.detail: Medical and motor-car rules do not establish every supply treatment or input-tax exception.

IRAS.topic: Treaty-specific WHT and individual-company ECI outcome
IRAS.detail: Payment classification, work location, treaty eligibility and payment dates or revenue and tax-adjusted ECI still need facts; general guidance must remain available.

CPF.topic: Age/percentage and birthday phrasing; PR conversion-date fact role; wage-band boundary phrasing
CPF.detail: PR conversion facts may be treated as a historical-law request; supported 2026 tables do not cure interpretation errors. Independently frozen $50/$500 boundary questions fail topic/issue reconciliation identically in base and final; this is not a missing payroll-facts failure.

CPF.topic: AW year-end recalculation in natural-language answer
CPF.detail: The selected quotations contain isolated examples instead of the complete recalculation rule, despite richer retained source and metadata.

The typed calculator requires explicit population, status/birth dates, classified OW/AW, prior amounts and an annual OW estimate or final-settlement facts. It is not connected to natural-language extraction.

CPF.topic: Other payroll years and special populations
CPF.detail: The calculator is limited to retained 2026 private-sector/non-pensionable schedules; it excludes platform workers and other unsupported populations.

MOM.topic: Employer-termination, holiday absence and weekend-holiday wording
MOM.detail: The substantive rule is present but these question forms do not reach the correct supported issue.

MOM.topic: Actual salary, overtime, leave balance and holiday pay
MOM.detail: Employment Act/Part IV scope, wage basis, hours, service length, schedule, prior leave and absence facts remain necessary.

MOM.topic: Further leave, termination disputes and special employee categories
MOM.detail: This batch does not implement every parental-leave or termination obligation; existing regular-salary and overtime rules are preserved, not claimed as new.

MAS.detail: No complete QDC-specific admitted official proof; exact return obligations remain unsupported.
SFA 04-N24 explicitly starts on 01/01/2027 and cannot establish the earlier regime. Safe temporal abstention is not a knowledge gain.

MAS.topic: Manager toolkit versus fund obligations under fresh wording
MAS.detail: The selected answer contains general licensing quotes; another manager-versus-fund question is correct, so support is wording-sensitive.

MAS.topic: Fund-level returns and complete regulatory notifications
MAS.detail: Manager-level LFMC/VCFM guidance and the future misconduct notice do not exhaust fund-level or non-SFA duties.

releaseBoundary: Coverage development is separate from historical ACRA release acceptance; no merge or deployment.
